item.title: hayakoe — Two Years Later, Surveyed TTS Models Again and Still Landed on VITS — Part 1
item.description:
Note: I’m based in Korea, so some context here is Korea-specific.

This is the first proper entry in the hayakoe series. The intro post is over at hayakoe — Building a TTS Library That’s Easy and Fast to Use — Intro .

One topic I touched on briefly in the intro was “I picked the model from scratch again.” In Part 1, I want to walk through that process in more detail.
